name: Living God
text:
You have reached heights of power equaling Razmir himself. You can Craft your Razmiri Mask out of porcelain laced with precious metals, or upgrade your existing mask to a porcelain one in the same time it takes to Craft one made of iron. A Porcelain Razmiri Mask grants a +4 item bonus to Deception checks to Lie or Feint, is an 18th-level item, and is an apex item that increases your Charisma modifier by 1 or increases it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value. It also gives you the following activation in addition to those granted by the standard, silver, and gold masks.

---
Activate—Power of the Living God 1 (concentrate, manipulate, occult)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect You demand power from the world, using your mask as a locus to force reality to bend to your will. You cast Manifestation as a 10th-rank occult spell, but no matter what spell you emulate with it, that spell has the incapacitation trait.
